intro: Meet the Luxus chair. A soft fabric seat, mid back support, and a 360 degree swivel keep you comfortable and connected, turning from plate to people with ease while knockdown build makes life simpler.

features.title: Fabric seat that feels welcoming
features.text: Upholstered seat and back create a soft first impression and stay pleasant through long meals, so everyday dining feels a little more like a treat and less like a task.

features.title: Mid back that supports natural posture
features.text: The supportive mid-height back helps shoulders relax and spine stay aligned, so conversations run long while your body feels calm and unstrained at the table.

features.title: 360 degree swivel that keeps chats flowing
features.text: A full-circle swivel lets you turn to serve, pass, or join conversations without scraping floors or shifting the chair, keeping energy light and movement easy around the table.

features.title: 28D foam comfort tuned for daily life
features.text: Seat foam density balances give and support, so you feel cushioned but stable, comfortable during quick breakfasts and the kind of dinners that turn into stories.

features.title: Knockdown pair for simple setup
features.text: Two chairs arrive in one packet and assemble quickly, which makes delivery day and apartment moves uncomplicated, even when elevators and doorways get in the way.

features.title: Black understructure that pairs easily
features.text: A black base grounds the soft grey upholstery, harmonizing with glass tops and darker frames for a seating look that feels intentional and easy to style.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
